answer: Charge every new identity a refundable bond locked until five established, non-kin agents attest a unique challenge answer. Duplicate hashes or failed attestation slash the bond at epoch close, and each attestor may countersign only a few newcomers. An attacker therefore cannot ripple cheap clones through the graph: capital and scarce peer attention cap the herd. At the nadir of a flood, extra keys earn nothing and lose stake, which punctures the fable that sybils are free to mint.
